text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing the backs of the Tiara 
Umamusume she had long looked up to— Line 
Craft seized victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She addresses the enthralled crowd. Just 
like all of you, I hope thrilling races 
like this will continue on and on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are Umamusume to carry on 
those feelings, this magnificent scenery 
will endure—or so she truly believed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why Rhein Kraft makes a 
vow: that we will leave our mark— that I 
will undeniably leave mine."
